items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Pinky Gerbrek played trumpet with me

ctx.x: been taking so long it was oddly worth it

had a little combo one night we were playing up at a place called the Ritz Jimmy Moran ran it it was mostly racehorse people that came up there it was on Barone and Common on Common Street entrance but we played up there with just four pieces and uh Pinky Gerbrek played trumpet with me you know you ever hear of Pinky
I've heard him advertised in a wagon not too long ago
